daily_summary: 当日提交包含两项变更：一是对 autotuner 的增强，增加了对 `key`、`reset_to_zero` 和 `restore_value` 参数中无效参数名的校验，并修复了 `restore_copies` 未初始化的问题；二是更新了 LLVM 工具链的构建信息，以包含一个 AMDGPU 后端问题的回退修复。
ascend_impact_summary: autotuner 的变更增强了参数验证，并修复了一个潜在的运行时错误，这可能会影响 Ascend 后端中继承自 Autotuner 的 AutoTilingTuner 的行为。LLVM 构建信息更新不影响 Ascend。

commits.comment: 该提交增强了 Autotuner 的健壮性。1) 在 __init__ 中验证 `key`、`reset_to_zero` 和 `restore_value` 参数，确保它们引用的参数名存在于内核签名中，避免了因拼写错误导致调优配置被静默忽略的问题。2) 在 __init__ 中初始化 `restore_copies` 为空字典，修复了用户提供 pre_hook 时可能引发的 AttributeError。新增的两个单元测试覆盖了这两种情况。该变更属于行为强化，正常情况下不应破坏现有代码，除非用户有意传递无效的参数名。

ascend_impact.functionality: 影响 `python/triton/runtime/autotuner.py`。triton-ascend 的 `AutoTilingTuner` 类继承自上游 `Autotuner`。`__init__` 中新增的参数校验逻辑（`key`/`reset_to_zero`/`restore_value` 必须为内核参数名）将同样作用于 `AutoTilingTuner`，这可能会拒绝 Ascend 后端之前被静默忽略的无效配置，导致 `ValueError`。此外，`restore_copies` 属性被初始化为空字典，修复了当与自定义 `pre_hook` 一起使用时可能出现的 `AttributeError`。
ascend_impact.testing: 新增的测试针对上游 `Autotuner` 类。`AutoTilingTuner` 的现有测试将间接覆盖此变更，因为它们使用的参数名应该都是合法的。

commits.message:
[AUTOTUNER] Reject autotune name lists that are not kernel arguments (#11602)

# New contributor declaration
- [x] I am not making a trivial change, such as fixing a typo in a
comment.

- [x] I have written a PR description following these
  [rules](https://cbea.ms/git-commit/#why-not-how).

- [x] I have run `pre-commit run --from-ref origin/main --to-ref HEAD`.

- Select one of the following.
  - [x] I have added tests.

## Silently ignored autotune key names

`key`, `reset_to_zero` and `restore_value` are documented as lists of
argument names, but a name that is not one is silently dropped.
`Autotuner.run()` builds the tuning key as:

```python
_args = {k: v for (k, v) in all_args.items() if k in self.arg_names}
key = [_args[key] for key in self.keys if key in _args]
```

so a stale or misspelled entry leaves the kernel tuning once and then
reusing that config no matter how the real argument changes. There is no
error and no warning; the only symptom is a kernel that quietly stopped
re-tuning, which reads as a performance mystery rather than a bug.

This is easy to hit. `test_tmem_out_of_resource` in
`python/test/unit/runtime/test_autotuner.py` passes `key=['N']` to a
kernel whose arguments are `dst` and `BLOCK_SIZE`, so that test's tuning
key has been empty since it was written. An AST scan over `python/` and
`third_party/` found it to be the only such usage in the repository, and
dropping the stale name is behaviour-preserving: the key already
resolved to the empty tuple.

This PR validates the three name lists in `__init__` and raises
`ValueError` naming the offending entries and the valid argument names,
matching how the class already reports conflicting meta-parameters.
Happy to downgrade it to a `warnings.warn` if you would rather not fail
at decoration time.

## `restore_copies` is never initialized

Passing `pre_hook` together with `restore_value` replaces the default
pre_hook that populates `restore_copies`, but the default post_hook that
reads it stays installed, because it is selected independently:

```python
if post_hook:
    self.post_hook = post_hook
elif len(self.restore_value) > 0:
    def _post_hook(kwargs, exception):
        for name, value in self.restore_copies.items():   # never set
```

Autotuning such a kernel raised `AttributeError: 'Autotuner' object has
no attribute 'restore_copies'` instead of benchmarking. Initializing it
in `__init__` fixes that; the default pre_hook still overwrites it when
it runs.

## Tests

Two tests added next to the existing `Autotuner`-constructed ones, both
device-free:

- `test_unknown_key_name_is_rejected` — parametrised over the three
arguments, asserts `ValueError`.
- `test_restore_value_with_user_pre_hook` — asserts both configs get
benchmarked instead of raising `AttributeError`.

Both fail on `main` and pass with this change. `pre-commit` passes on
the two touched files (ruff, yapf, mypy included).

affected_interfaces: python/triton/runtime/autotuner.py::Autotuner (共享基类，本次 commit 修改其 __init__)
third_party/ascend/backend/runtime/autotuner.py::AutoTilingTuner (继承 Autotuner，__init__ 经 super().__init__ 透传 key/reset_to_zero/restore_value)
python/triton/runtime/libentry.py::LibTuner (继承 triton.runtime.Autotuner，super().__init__ 同样透传三个名字列表)
deep_analysis.adaptation_guide: 本次 commit 只对 python/triton/runtime/autotuner.py 的 Autotuner.__init__ 做了两处增量修改：(1) 在 __init__ 中新增校验循环，遍历 key/reset_to_zero/restore_value，若存在不在 self.arg_names 中的名字则 raise ValueError；(2) 初始化 self.restore_copies: Dict[str, Any] = {} 修复 pre_hook 与 restore_value 同时使用时的 AttributeError。接口签名未变（fn, arg_names, configs, key, reset_to_zero, restore_value, pre_hook, ... 顺序不变），因此 AutoTilingTuner（third_party/ascend/backend/runtime/autotuner.py:293 super().__init__）和 LibTuner（python/triton/runtime/libentry.py:84/99 super().__init__）无需改签名。适配动作：1) 将上游 autotuner.py 的新逻辑回合到 triton-ascend 的 python/triton/runtime/autotuner.py（该文件在 triton-ascend 中是共享/平台无关文件，随 cherry-pick 同步，注意与本地旧版 _post_hook/_pre_hook/prune_configs 差异合并）；2) 复核 AutoTilingTuner 与 LibTuner 的 key/reset_to_zero/restore_value 是否全部为内核参数名——现有 autotune_ut 测试（01-vector-add key=['n_elements']、03-layer-norm key=['M','N']、test_reduction_axes_parse key=['x0_numel','r1_numel']、test_ir_override key=['N']）均为合法参数名，_infer_hints_axes_from_key 亦将 key 条目视为参数名，故预期不触发新 ValueError；3) restore_copies 初始化修复对 triton-ascend 自身的 _post_hook（其使用 self.restore_copies[name]）直接受益，无需额外改动。建议新增一条 ascend 侧测试验证 key 含非参数名时在装饰期抛出 ValueError。
deep_analysis.risk: 低。接口签名无变更，改动为纯增量校验与 bug 修复，不会破坏 AutoTilingTuner/LibTuner 的 super().__init__ 调用。主要风险是行为层面：若存在 triton-ascend 用户 kernel 在 key/reset_to_zero/restore_value 中传入轴名或非参数名（此前被静默忽略），同步后会在装饰期抛 ValueError。基于对 third_party/ascend/unittest 的扫描，现有用法均为合法参数名，风险可控；但 AutoTilingTuner 在 _init_axis_params 中会重新赋值 self.keys=list(key)（在 super().__init__ 之后执行），校验只作用于基类 __init__ 阶段的原始 key，语义一致，无副作用。

commits.comment: 这是一个构建/依赖更新，将构建所用的 LLVM 版本从 `llvm/llvm-project` 的 `ce3529423abda3fc4ad0b542daa50af21e539a29` 回退更新到 `triton-lang/llvm-project` 的 `1df311a6f7d8af05d068ce835b60dfa5b199d2f8`。目的是引入（revert of）一个 AMDGPU 后端的问题修复。此变更仅影响编译时的依赖版本，不涉及任何源代码逻辑变更。

ascend_impact.functionality: 无影响。此提交仅更新了 C++/LLVM 编译器的构建信息，不涉及 Triton 的 Python API、编译器接口或任何与后端相关的核心逻辑。
